title: Matrix action on the explicit finite free basis germs
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], x in an affine open U, A = Gamma(X,U), R = O_{X,x}, and H and b_p^(n) as in [def-sc-affine-free-basis-germs]. For natural numbers n and m and any A-linear f : ULift(Fin(n) -> A) -> ULift(Fin(m) -> A), H(f)(b_p^(n)) = sum_q germ((f(e_p))_q) b_q^(m) for every p in Fin(n).

source.place: Tag 01HV, Lemma 26.5.4 (7), natural associated-sheaf stalk localization; Tag 01IB, affine module sheafification; Tag 01C6, finite free sheaves; Tag 0098, restriction along the affine chart; direct-image stalk computed on the cofinal neighbourhoods contained in U

proof.text: Expand the composite of the p-th coordinate inclusion with f as the sum of the target coordinate inclusions composed with multiplication by the corresponding matrix entries. This is equality of coordinate tuples, valid also for empty target.

Apply the additive functor H to that identity and evaluate on its explicit regular unit germ. Scalar compatibility changes each summand into the germ of its matrix entry times the target basis germ; linearity of each H(i_q) completes the formula.

theorem affineFreeBasisGerm_map
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) (U : X.Opens) (hxU : x ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (n m : ℕ)
    (f : ModuleCat.of Γ(X, U) (ULift.{0} (Fin n → Γ(X, U))) ⟶
      ModuleCat.of Γ(X, U) (ULift.{0} (Fin m → Γ(X, U)))) (p : Fin n) :
    (affineFreeStalkFunctor X x U hU).map f (affineFreeBasisGerm X x U hxU hU n p) =
      ∑ q, X.presheaf.germ U x hxU ((f (ULift.up (Pi.single p 1))).down q) •
        affineFreeBasisGerm X x U hxU hU m q
